title: State Scholarship Classes 1-5
eligibility: Regular students of a recognized institution belonging to the Scheduled Caste category
benefits: State scholarship assistance to encourage education and provide financial support
documents_required: Required documents are to be submitted to the educational institution
application_process: Submit the application with required documents to the concerned educational institution
important_sections_or_clauses: The official record states the scheme began in 1966-67.
